text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I'm looking for ways to bring in new
fans at my next live.
As experts in your fields, please teach me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Calling us 'experts' is stretching it a bit~
I dunno if I can really be of much help
with the whole 'locodol' thing, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! Ace-san, you're a great senior from the countryside just like me...
and I heard you have experience producing vegetable sales!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And Crown-chan runs her own business,
so she's practically a marketing specialist!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan, goes without saying,
is a super famous influencer!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I can gain insights from all of you,
I'm sure I can put on a live that delights both current fans and new audiences alike!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... When ya pitch it with that much passion,
I can't turn ya down!
Alright! What do ya wanna know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...!
First, if there are any secrets to getting people to pick up the vegetables—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It ain't really a big secret or nothin'.
I just made sure folks could see who grew 'em, where, and with what kinda passion!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Like putting up pictures of the fields and my grandpa!
That way, buyers know exactly whose vegetables they're gettin' and can buy with peace of mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
When trying to tap into new customer segments,
it is crucial to spark both interest and surprise!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If the audience is unfamiliar with the subject,
no matter how passionately you present it,
it will be difficult to capture their hearts—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I recommend providing a hook to grab their interest first,
and then easing into the main topic from there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm♪ When growing followers on an established account,
it works pretty much the same way~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You create exciting, fresh content that captures everyone's eyes and put it out there.
Of course, staying true to your own cute style is a must♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and if you don't want it to just be a one-time viral trend,
keeping up a playful back-and-forth that makes them want to follow you long-term is super important too☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...っ! I see!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
I'll put all your advice to good use and make this the best live ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the academy,
I ran into Hokko Tarumae, who wore a troubled expression.
choice_data_list: What are you worrying about now?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san from the other day!
You see—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's advice was truly wonderful. That's why
I wanted to incorporate every single bit of it, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trying to fit all of it into the live
is turning out to be much harder than I thought...
choice_data_list: Why not ask for their advice again?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: N-No, I can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ace-san and the others who gave me advice, and Falco-san who performed for the shopping district folks,
they all thought things through and achieved success on their own—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I don't overcome my own obstacles,
it won't become my own real strength!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to make this the ultimate live.
To do that, I have to make people love Tomakomai and me through my own ideas and methods.
choice_data_list: ...Do you really need to cram everything into the live, though?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I have to! Because...!
choice_data_list: You could make use of those ideas outside of the live too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see... There are definitely things that would work better
spread through other channels rather than during the live itself.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan's idea goes to social media, and I can ask Ace-san for help with that.
Then connect it all back to the live—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
!
With this, I think I can make it work!!
choice_data_list: Glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
!
With this, I think I can make it work!!
choice_data_list: Glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's bound to go well!
After all, everyone... and you, Trainer-san, gave me such wonderful advice!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once the live's schedule is set, I'll invite you!
Please do come and watch!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, thanks to you, I feel like I've found a clue leading toward my goal!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much.
I will sprint down this path with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her resolute words,
I decided to pray for the success of her live show.
